/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 小新台湾 (Crayon Shin-chan TW) CBT 测试首周报告
模块编号 : 05 - 角色养成度与关卡推图进度对比 (TW CBT vs SG CBT/OBT)
数据表   : 
  - 小新繁体 CBT: ta.v_event_18 (AppID 18)
  - 小新新加坡  : ta.v_event_13 (AppID 13)
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_start_date,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_end_date
),
UserBlacklist13 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),
UserBlacklist18 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id
    FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users', 'is_windows', 'is_water')
),

-- 1. 小新繁体 CBT 关卡推图日志
TW_StageLogs AS (
    SELECT
        '1.小新繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        e."#account_id" AS user_id,
        COALESCE(CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS VARCHAR), CAST(e.stage_id AS VARCHAR), '0') AS stage_id,
        e."#event_time" AS event_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN ScanConfig sc
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist18 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(sc.tw_start_date AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(sc.tw_end_date AS VARCHAR)
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
),

-- 2. 新加坡 CBT 关卡推图日志
SG_StageLogs AS (
    SELECT
        '2.小新新加坡OBT1' AS cohort_name,
        e."#account_id" AS user_id,
        COALESCE(CAST(e.a_rst[1].id AS VARCHAR), CAST(e.stage_id AS VARCHAR), '0') AS stage_id,
        e."#event_time" AS event_time
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    LEFT JOIN UserBlacklist13 ub ON e."#user_id" = ub.user_id
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14'
      AND e."#event_name" = 'stage_fight'
      AND ub.user_id IS NULL
),

CombinedStage AS (
    SELECT * FROM TW_StageLogs
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SG_StageLogs
),

UserMaxStage AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        MAX(TRY_CAST(stage_id AS BIGINT)) AS max_stage_id
    FROM CombinedStage
    GROUP BY cohort_name, user_id
),

StageBuckets AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        CASE
            WHEN max_stage_id IS NULL OR max_stage_id = 0 THEN '01. 未推图/停留在新手关'
            WHEN max_stage_id <= 1005 THEN '02. 第一章 (主线1)'
            WHEN max_stage_id <= 2005 THEN '03. 第二章 (主线2)'
            WHEN max_stage_id <= 3005 THEN '04. 第三章 (主线3)'
            WHEN max_stage_id <= 5005 THEN '05. 第四-五章'
            ELSE '06. 第六章+'
        END AS stage_tier
    FROM UserMaxStage
)

SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比组",
    stage_tier AS "推图最高关卡区间",
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "用户数",
    ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_name), 2) AS "占比(%)"
FROM StageBuckets
GROUP BY cohort_name, stage_tier
ORDER BY "对比组", "推图最高关卡区间"
